desc: Implement pure-Python parity-split big-integer convolution solution as described in the next task
Verify correctness on all samples and edge cases: N < 3, all values same parity, sparse sets, dense sets up to 10^6, and max_val = 10^6
Optimize runtime/memory if needed: localize struct.unpack_from, delete intermediates, pad byte buffers for safe 4-byte reads, and avoid unnecessary copies
If the big-integer approach times out or fails, implement a numpy FFT fallback using self-convolution of the binary indicator and rounding coefficients
